headlines: Chip and AI rout deepens: NVDA -8.8%, AMD -16.4%, MU -16.3%, SNDK -20.7%, NBIS -19%, SOXL -35%, QQQ -6% on Stocktwits trending
SPY near 739 (-3.6%), QQQ -6%, IWM -2.3% per Stocklake
US nonfarm payrolls due tomorrow 13:30 UTC (prior 29); ADP 86 vs 90 and ISM services 54.5 vs 54.9 came out yesterday

rumors.text: Posters blame the Democratic midterm result for expected limits on the AI buildout and say the AI trade will keep cracking
rumors.why: If policy fears persist, AI-heavy index weights keep dragging SPY and QQQ

rumors.text: Bloomberg reportedly says the high-volume selloff looks like algos offloading
rumors.why: Mechanical selling can overshoot and reverse, but can also feed on itself

rumors.text: Posters warn of end-of-day margin calls from leveraged funds long semis
rumors.why: Forced liquidation into the close could extend the drop

rumors.text: Some posters call for a violent rebound and say not to sell the lows
rumors.why: Dip-buying and capitulation could trigger a bounce

plays.reason: Selloff is accelerating with talk of forced selling into the close; momentum still negative
plays.catalyst: Possible margin-call liquidation into the close

plays.reason: A -3.6% day with SPY RSI near 38 and QQQ RSI near 29 often sees a partial bounce, though payrolls is a risk
plays.catalyst: Oversold bounce vs payrolls tomorrow 13:30 UTC

readings.whats_new: The slide worsened sharply since the last reading: SPY is about -3.6% (was -1.15%) and QQQ about -6%, with chip names down 9-20%. Stocktwits SPY sentiment fell to 28 from 33 and talk now centers on forced selling into the close. Reddit was blocked and web search found no same-day coverage.
